items.title: 274 racers and 56 teams in Busan: the largest race in RoboRacer history
items.excerpt: The 29th RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition ran August 24 to 27, 2026 at BEXCO in Busan, during the IFAC World Congress. Every team built its own car. InTheEND won, DDRX came second, and SMOC and 4D-REPUBLIC reached the semi-finals.

items.title: Registration for the 31st competition at IROS 2026 closes September 5
items.excerpt: The competition runs September 28 to 30, 2026 at the David L. Lawrence Convention Center in Pittsburgh. Check-in and practice are on September 27. Up to four cars race at once. Register your team by September 5.

items.title: The 29th competition opens in Busan on August 24
items.excerpt: The competition runs August 24 to 27, 2026 at BEXCO in Busan, Republic of Korea. Teams bring their own 1/10-scale car and software.
